thread:
lara: Postmortem uploaded: short summary - BGP reflector churn combined with low client DNS caches (TTL 20s) led to out-of-sync route advertisements and a burst of TLS renegotiation failures on cross-region paths (ap-southeast-1 -> us-west-2). Full writeup: https://redwood-internal/pms/248099.

sam: saw it in the dashboards — tls_renegotiation_count spiked ~11:24-11:38 UTC. the SNI mismatch alerts lined up with BGP flap events.

lara: exact sequence in section 3. tl;dr: reflector restart -> short window where some edge routers used stale next-hops -> connections retried and some backends returned TLS alerts until DNS re-resolve aligned.

sre-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-052. Alerts for tls_renegotiation_count auto-suppressed for 1h while mitigation is applied. :information_source:

net-eng-ana: immediate mitigation plan: 1) emergency DNS TTL increase to 600s for affected service records (owner: net-eng-ana, ETA: 6h) 2) pause BGP reflector rolling restart (owner: ops-jon, ETA: 30m) 3) add sanity-check to route-publisher to reject publishes when reflectors report >2nd-degree instability (owner: eli, ETA: 5d) 4) audit clients for aggressive resolver behavior and publish guidance (owner: sam, ETA: 4d).

ops-jon: paused the roll at 11:33 UTC. leaving one reflector in warm standby and monitoring. will push TTL change once approvals are green.

lara: sam can you paste the grafana panel link for the TLS chart here? want to include in postmortem digest.

sam: panels: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/tls-overview?from=now-2h&to=now - look at the "tls_renegotiation_count by src_region" panel.

eli: PR for publisher guard started: https://git.redwood/routing/publish-guard/PR-87 - includes checks for reflector health and a dry-run flag. reviewers: @net-eng-ana @ops-jon.

net-eng-ana: executing TTL change in 15m window. command to validate after change: 
``` 
dig +short SOA svc.example.redwood.net @ns1.redwood.net
curl -I https://svc.example.redwood.net/health -H "Host: svc.example.redwood.net"
```

ops-jon: TTL bump applied at 12:02 UTC. confirmed via dig: SOA shows minimum 600. quick smoke shows TLS err_rate falling back to baseline ~12:10 UTC.

sre-bot: Note: Scheduled follow-ups created: JIRA NET-412 (publisher-guard), JIRA NET-413 (DNS-ttl-emergency), JIRA NET-414 (client-resolver-audit).

lara: agreed follow-ups and owners: - NET-413 (net-eng-ana, 6h) - NET-412 (eli, 5d) - NET-414 (sam, 4d) - Runbook update for BGP reflector restarts (ops-jon, 7d). I'll add to the weekly networking reliability board.

sam: suggestion: add a checkbox in postmortem template: "any recent control-plane restarts affecting active routes?" would have flagged this earlier. owner: sam to propose change.

eli: for observability, I'll add per-reflector heartbeat to the route health dashboard and break down TLS metrics by reflector-id. filing OBS ticket OBS-221.

lara: thanks team. will follow up with the digest and an entry in the recurring-incident tracker (pattern: control-plane churn + low DNS TTL). ping here if you hit any blockers on JIRA/PRs. :spiral_calendar:
